Aries: An offhand comment by your partner causes you to react with anger. Before you say something you don't mean, give yourself a moment to cool down. You may be better off letting it go.
Taurus: Don't let petty jealousy get in the way of enjoying your time with your honey. Getting worked up over a minor flirtation with someone else isn't worth the fight. Their heart belongs to you.
Gemini: You've been trying to juggle so many things lately that you're having trouble finding your focus. Set your worries aside and focus on the positive. A quiet night with your honey would be ideal.
Cancer: If something doesn't feel right to you now, wait until you feel sure. Talking to your partner can help you sort out how you feel, and don't forget the importance of listening to your gut instinct.
Leo: Be on the lookout for someone who wants to cause trouble for you and your honey. If you see someone who's up to no good, let them know you won't stand for it and they'll back down.
Virgo: You're feeling a little restless, so get out and do some exploring today. Ask your honey to take you someplace you've never been. Next weekend, you can do the same for them.
Libra: Being generous with your honey is part of the fun of being in a couple. Why not surprise them with a little treat today? You don't have to spend a lot, just choose something with a personal meeting.
Scorpio: Your days of struggle are coming to an end. Now you're feeling like you've been reborn as an even stronger version of yourself. Celebrate the good times to come with your loved one.
Sagittarius: Your desire for your honey has been kicked up a few notches today. Start the evening early by sending them a flirtatious text message -- or even better, a racy camera phone shot!
Capricorn: Your sweetheart's been acting a little odd lately, and you're not sure why. Talking to a friend can help. They might be able to offer you a different perspective. Perhaps you're making something out of nothing.
Aquarius: Right now you're craving privacy for you and your loved one. If you can't get it at home, make some plans to spend a night or two away. The destination isn't important, as long as you can be together.
Pisces: The next few days will be a time of emotional upheaval. At times it will not be easy for you and your loved one, but when it's over, you'll feel stronger and more sure of your commitment than ever.
